name: Sonar
description: Lightweight search-augmented model for fast, cited answers.
longDescription: Sonar is Perplexity's standard search-augmented model, optimized for speed while still providing web-grounded, cited answers. It is ideal for applications that need real-time information access with lower latency than Sonar Pro.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.perplexity.ai",
    api_key="YOUR_PERPLEXITY_API_KEY"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="sonar",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the weather today?"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
